title: A comprehensive analysis of combined stormwater overflow (CSO) discharges to coastal waters and data communications by a UK water company between 2021 and 2023
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2516-2528
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00693C, Paper
Alex T. Ford, Richard Boakes, James Richardson, Mike Owens
Event Duration Monitors (EDMs) for stormwater overflows record millions of hours of sewage discharges per year in England. We provide a critical overview of how information is presented to the public.
